Crataegus has been used in homoeopathic medicines under the following names: Crataegus oxyacantha; Crat. oxy. ◊ Crataegus is used in herbal medicine for cardiovascular disor- ders.1-4 A systematic review4 of controlled studies concluded that it shows significant benefit compared with placebo as an adjunc- tive treatment for chronic heart failure.
